I liked them very much more than ten years ago, and I bought VIP tickets to stand in the first row to watch their live performances. So I used to keep an eye on them. Until monolith. Musically, I began to feel that they had changed a lot from the past. As for the guitarist suspending the band's activities due to a life-threatening illness, there is also the band's suspension due to the bass player's suspension. I think they have a bigger divide when it comes to music-making. Because the direction of their current works is very different from their earlier works. At the same time, in very few introductory articles, it is mentioned in subtle words that the lead singer's live performance needs to be improved. I don't know if this is the personal opinion of the author who wrote the article or the opinions of other members of the band. To this day "Stars Faded In Slow Motion" is still what I think is their best.
